cases.situation: Freelance copywriter. A startup offered $3,000 for a 12-page website. My rate would put it at $4,500. They say the budget is fixed.
cases.reply: Thanks, Priya, I'd really like to write this one. For 12 pages with the customer interviews we discussed, my price is $4,500, and that's where I need to be to do it well. If $3,000 is fixed, I can scope to fit: the six core pages for $3,000 now, and the rest as a second phase when you're ready. Would that work?
cases.note: Hold the rate, move the scope. Lowering the price for the same work resets every future quote.

cases.situation: 在公司两年了，今年负责的项目帮公司省了120万成本。现在月薪18k，市场上同岗位大概22k到25k，想跟刘总谈加薪。
cases.reply: 刘总，我想和您聊一下我的薪资。过去一年，我负责的供应链系统项目为公司节省了120万成本，另外带新人把交付周期缩短了两周。我了解了一下市场，同岗位大概在22k到25k，我现在是18k。我希望调整到24k。您看需要怎样才能做到？
cases.note: 给一个具体数字而不是范围，理由讲贡献和市场，不讲房贷。说完数字后可以沉默，等对方先开口。

cases.situation: Ich will ein gebrauchtes Rennrad kaufen, angeboten für 850 Euro auf Kleinanzeigen. Ich kann morgen bar zahlen und würde gern um die 700 bieten.
cases.reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, das Rennrad interessiert mich sehr, und ich könnte es morgen Abend abholen. Würden Sie es für 720 Euro abgeben? Das liegt unter Ihrem Preis, dafür zahle ich bar und sofort.
cases.note: A specific number plus the real lever (cash, tomorrow) beats asking whether the price is negotiable.

cases.situation: My landlord, Mr. Okafor, wants to raise my rent from $2,100 to $2,350 when my lease renews Dec 1. I've been there three years and always paid on time. Similar 1-bedrooms nearby list around $2,250. I'd be happy landing at $2,200.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Okafor, thanks for the heads-up about the renewal. I'd really like to stay; this has been a great home for three years. The new rent is a jump of about 12%, and comparable one-bedrooms on our street are listing around $2,250. Would you take $2,175 on an 18-month lease? You'd keep a tenant who has paid on time every month, with no vacancy or turnover costs. If 18 months doesn't suit you, I'm open to a different lease length.
cases.note: Anchor a little under your real target, tie it to their value (reliability, no vacancy), and keep lease length as the second lever if money doesn't move.

cases.situation: Got an offer as senior UX researcher at Hollis Health for $118k. I asked for $128k and the recruiter, Megan, came back saying $118k is the top of the band. I still want the job.
cases.reply: Thanks for checking, Megan, and for going back to them. I'm excited about this role, so let's look at the rest of the package. Would they do a $7,500 signing bonus and a formal salary review at six months instead of twelve? With those two in writing, I'm ready to sign this week.
cases.note: After a firm no on base salary: move to one-off money and timing, and make the path to yes explicit.

cases.situation: 我开咖啡店，现在的烘豆商报价每公斤128元，我每月大概用40公斤。另一家报115，但我更喜欢现在这家的豆子。想谈到118左右。
cases.reply: 刘经理，您家的埃塞豆子客人一直很喜欢，我很想继续长期合作。现在每月大概40公斤，报价是每公斤128元；我这边看到的同类报价在115左右，所以想跟您商量能不能做到116。如果我签六个月的固定订单、每月1号提前付款，价格这边有没有空间？
cases.note: 买方开价略低于自己能接受的数，同时拿出对方在意的东西（固定量、提前付款）来换。

cases.situation: I'm selling my 2019 Honda Civic, 48,000 miles, listed at $17,500 on Facebook Marketplace. Private-party value is around $17,000. A buyer, Luis, offered $14,000 cash. I'd take $16,500.
cases.reply: Thanks for the offer, Luis, and cash works well for me. $14,000 is too far under for this car: it has 48,000 miles, a full service history, and private-party value is around $17,000. I can do $16,900 if you can pick it up this week. Want to come and see it Thursday after 5?
cases.note: Seller side: don't split the difference with a lowball. Counter once with a specific number just above your floor and one fact about value, then hold.
